title: City Council District 3
statement: San Antonio isn’t just another neighborhood—it’s the heart of D3’s resilience. With sentiment lagging and crime above city averages, we double down on community-led safety investments and neighborhood revitalization. The covenant renewal grants merchant protections—this is how we anchor stability in our corridors.

payload.text: I concur on the INIT-003 design consultant selection and submit District 3 intake verification for the Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline cohort review.
